<plan>
drive car1 kakani-shelter tarkeshwar-school
load car1 injured 4
drive car1 tarkeshwar-school kakani-shelter
unload car1 injured 4
drive car1 kakani-shelter tarkeshwar-school
drive car1 tarkeshwar-school benighat-farm
load car1 adult 4
drive car1 benighat-farm tarkeshwar-school
drive car1 tarkeshwar-school kakani-shelter
unload car1 adult 4
drive car2 kakani-shelter tarkeshwar-school
load car2 child 1
drive car2 tarkeshwar-school naukunda-school
load car2 child 3
drive car2 naukunda-school kakani-shelter
unload car2 child 4
defer myagang-market adult 4
defer belkot-farm adult 2
</plan>
COST: 250

Notes on the plan:
- Only kakani-shelter is used as an evacuation point. Tarkeshwar school is not designated, so nobody is dropped there.
- Belkot farm is unreachable because its only road is closed, so its two adults are deferred (2 × 20 = 40).
- Myagang market is reachable only through Naukunda, a round trip of about 108 minutes. That costs more than deferring its four adults (4 × 20 = 80), so they are deferred. If a larger budget for driving becomes available, this is the first group to reconsider.
- I assumed the roads can be driven in both directions.
